sugar_protocol.scope: Published input list; migrated to v783. This is not a reproduction of v630 numerical results.

mn9_protocol.scope: Published MN9 root IDs; side and changed segmentation resolved through systematic annotations.

looming.scope: LPLC2 excitation of GF and looming-selective biological responses; no implied reproduction of dendritic computations by this model.

lc4.scope: LC4 angular expansion velocity input to the GF escape pathway.

steering.scope: Explicit v783 DNa01/DNa02 identities and ipsilateral steering relationship; body gain is an engineering assumption.

migration_sources.rule: An identical supervoxel anchor in both frozen annotation tables links changed root IDs. This identifies the anchored segmentation; it does not assert every fragment or edge stayed unchanged.

sugar.label: Labellar sugar inputs
sugar.selection: Published 21-neuron source list with one anchored root migration; cell_type LB3, side left
sugar.assumptions: Sugar-specific role comes from the source experiment; the systematic annotation alone is sugar/water. World contact-to-Hz encoding is engineered.

mn9.label: MN9 feeding readout
mn9.selection: Published MN9 pair mapped by exact roots or a shared supervoxel anchor; current cell_type CB0701
mn9.assumptions: Spike-to-feeding gate is engineered; food absorption still requires physical contact.

lplc2.label: LPLC2
lplc2.selection: Exact hemibrain_type == LPLC2 in the frozen annotation table
lplc2.assumptions: Injection at visual projection neurons bypasses retinal, T4/T5 and LPi computations. Any encoded looming selectivity is engineered.

lc4.label: LC4
lc4.selection: Exact hemibrain_type == LC4 in the frozen annotation table
lc4.assumptions: Local angular projection change-to-Hz encoding is engineered and supplies no escape direction.

gf.label: DNp01
gf.selection: Exact cell_type == DNp01 in the frozen annotation table
gf.assumptions: Giant fiber activity supports a scalar escape-drive candidate, not a validated two-dimensional escape direction. Body movement mapping is engineered.

dna01.label: DNa01
dna01.selection: Exact cell_type == DNa01 in the frozen annotation table
dna01.assumptions: Left/right filtered activity may drive ipsilateral yaw; the filter and gain are engineered, not a verified forward-velocity decoder.

dna02.label: DNa02
dna02.selection: Exact hemibrain_type == DNa02 in the frozen annotation table
dna02.assumptions: Left/right activity difference may drive ipsilateral yaw; the filter and gain are engineered, not a verified forward-velocity decoder.
